groups.label: RER D
groups.source: idfm.zip routes.txt route_color 008B5B on RER D (route_id IDFM:C01728). Pinned at the source step dL 0 (trail #63c997): at -0.12 (#3aa273) it sat at RER A's lightness and was 0.029 from RER A under deuteranopia on the Châtelet to Gare de Lyon corridor the two share, and 0.043 from the Other grey (Transilien lines run beside it for 114 km). Now 0.115 deutan and 0.210 protan from RER A, 0.095 and 0.128 from the grey. It is 0.077 from the slate city line, a renderer warning, which the batch accepts as New York's B/D/F/M (0.069) and Chicago's Orange Line (0.067) did; RER D crosses the city line at two points only
